posts.name: Wynn
posts.cooked:
Guys!

 

If you are on these boards and have not pre-ordered Spirit Island Digital I would highly recommend that you check it out. I've been playing the heck out of the beta and it is awesome. It recreates the feel of the tabletop while handling all of the setup and rules execution so you can play so many more games!

 

There is still one stretch goal to unlock, and I really want to see huge support for the game at launch so that we get the expansions right quick. 

 

This has been a Public Service Announcement. Thank you for your attention : )

posts.name: liarliar
posts.cooked:
I have been watching the videos and I’m VERY excited for it. Initially I most wanted to play Shadows Flicker Like Flame, and they’re still high on my list, but I’ve also learned to love Thunder-Speaker, Vital Strength, Bringer Of Dreams and Nightmares...it will probably be a while before I play Ocean’s Hungry Grasp, but I definitely want to.

I also want to make theme-teams, like The Pushing Team (Dreams plus Hungry Grasp) or The Dahan Team (River Surges, Thunder-Speaker, and Shadows Flicker)...it looks like so much fun :D
